definitions.gloss: youth; young people; adolescents and young adults
definitions.explanation: A collective term for young people, typically ranging from adolescents to those in their early twenties. Often used in official, legal, or institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: {青少年|せいしょうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: We are putting effort into nurturing young people.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{青少年|せいしょうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪影響|あくえいきょう}→悪影響：16840_akueikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This movie may have a bad influence on young people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{青少年|せいしょうねん}⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A local youth development organization is carrying out volunteer activities.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal term used in official, educational, and media contexts. Combines ⟦{青年|せいねん}→青年：03292_seinen⟧ (young adult) and ⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧ (boy/adolescent) to cover a broad age range. Commonly appears in laws, regulations, and organizational names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青少年|せいしょうねん}⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧ (youth development)
- {青少年|せいしょうねん}⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧ (youth protection)
- {青少年|せいしょうねん}⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧ (juvenile crime)
- {青少年|せいしょうねん}⟦{健全|けんぜん}→健全：11539_kenzen⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧ (youth healthy development ordinance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧: young people — casual and conversational
- ⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧: boy, juvenile — narrower age range, typically under 18
- ⟦{青年|せいねん}→青年：03292_seinen⟧: young adult — typically late teens to mid-twenties
